summary: R57 deterministic CallExpr mode, call-shape, candidate-domain and responsibility admission; product checker NOT_RUN.
requires: exactly one CallMode is selected from Ordinary, Message and ActorMessage
the complete selector path and one ordered CallArgument family are preserved before resolution
outer-comma ownership, rank-15 associativity and terminal actor-call rules are structurally admitted
the candidate domain, call shape, ownership, effects, errors, isolation, authority and cleanup close to exactly one CallPlan
ActorMessage selects ActorTransport only and never falls back to ordinary dispatch
preconditions: the parser has produced one CallExpr and preserved the complete selector and ordered source arguments
the call mode belongs to the closed Ordinary, Message or ActorMessage enum
all structural grouping and terminality checks precede candidate ranking
normalization: normalize selector identity, CallMode, labels, unfold channels, trailing closures, expected formal channels and responsibility axes without synthesizing a message payload aggregate
decision_procedure: validate the closed RCTS-V5 call descriptor
select the exact mode-owned candidate domain
reject an unparenthesized nested tilde call before an outer comma
reject nonterminal or chained ActorMessage syntax
reject actor operations reached through Message mode
rank fixed arity before repeated positional before named rest
close ownership, effects, errors, isolation, authority and cleanup
seal one CallPlan or emit the deterministic diagnostic
termination_metric: finite preserved argument vector plus finite statically resolved candidate domain
evaluation_order: structural preconditions -> mode-owned domain -> StaticCallShapeAdmitted -> unique winner -> responsibility closure -> diagnostic
